episodes.title: The UFO Cult That Promised God Would Appear on Live TV
episodes.description:
Today we will be investigating Chen Tao, the weird UFO cult that took over a town in Texas and said that God would appear on television. This is everything about their journey, including the start in Taiwan, the move to California, Texas, and their inevitable exodus.
